purpose: Defines one Calendar acquisition campaign containing zero or more independently valid Collection Jobs without forcing shared runner, scope, rank target, review cohort, or promotion transaction semantics. A zero-job plan is the explicit steady-state result when no acquisition work is due.
closure_rules: plan_id and campaign_id must be lowercase kebab-case stable identifiers
created_at must be a valid date-time
jobs must be an array and may be empty when no acquisition work is due
every present job must validate independently against the Collection Job contract and Acquisition Registry
every present job campaign_id must equal the plan campaign_id
job_id values must be unique within the plan
jobs may use different systems runners scopes collection modes rank strategies target ranks and reasons
one lower-rank target must not change another job target rank or strategy
one execution source error must remain scoped to its job and must not rewrite unrelated outcomes
a zero-job plan is an auditable successful planning result and must not be rewritten as a failure
a Collection Plan is not a common review cohort
a Collection Plan is not a common promotion transaction
a Collection Plan must not duplicate source IDs adapter IDs credentials source bodies publication state or promotion state
explicit_exclusions: no source_id or adapter_id duplication at plan level
no source bodies or raw HTML
no participant horse jockey trainer betting odds result payout prediction or tip data
no credentials cookies tokens restricted-access details or bypass instructions
no approval promotion publication or deployment side effects
